LINE: headscale users |
  [create  (Create a local user)] [get     (Show one user)] [list    (List the users)] [set     (Change a local user)]
LINE: headscale users list --|
  [--columns       (Columns to show: a list, or +name and -name to change the default)] [--config        (Config file)] [--filter        (Keep the rows that match; may be repeated)] [--help          (Show this help)] [--list-columns  (List the columns, the API field behind each, and exit)] [--output        (Output format: json (the API object))] [--sort          (Column to sort by; -name sorts in reverse)]
LINE: headscale users list --columns id,na|
  [id`,name]
LINE: headscale users list --columns +lo|
  [+login-name ]
LINE: headscale users list --sort -co|
  [-count ]
LINE: headscale users list --filter=pro|
  [--filter=profile-pic-url] [--filter=provider] [--filter=provider-id]
LINE: headscale users set alice --|
  [--config        (Config file)] [--display-name  (New display name; "" clears it)] [--email         (New email address; "" clears it)] [--help          (Show this help)] [--name          (New username)] [--output        (Output format: json (the API object))] [--picture-url   (New profile picture URL; "" clears it)]
